title: UMAT-OTI: Deterministic order-truncated imaginary tangent generation for Abaqus UMATs
description: UMAT-OTI transforms Abaqus user-material subroutine (UMAT) Fortran source so that the consistent material tangent (DDSDDE), and optional internal constitutive Jacobians, are computed by order-truncated imaginary (OTI) automatic differentiation instead of hand-coded or finite-difference derivatives. The transformation is driven by a compact JSON contract and preserves the external UMAT interface expected by Abaqus. This release accompanies the SoftwareX submission describing the method.
